draft.subject: Next step for Summit Studio in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Nice work getting your first project set up in Wrenfield last week — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's the right foundation.

The usual next step is bringing someone else in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through what the rest of your team should see first and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Priya
